Frontend Engineer — Globex LLC

Location: Remote (EU)
Employment type: Full-time

Globex LLC is building a new customer-facing web application and needs a Frontend Engineer to help ship it.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain customer-facing web applications.
- Collaborate with design on UI implementation.
- Improve front-end performance and accessibility.

Requirements:
- 3+ years frontend experience
- React proficiency
- Familiarity with TypeScript

(Salary not disclosed in this posting.)

mockResult.responsibilitiesSummary: Build and maintain customer-facing web applications, collaborate with design on UI implementation, and improve front-end performance and accessibility.
